
Figure\ \@ref(fig:PoissonGammaExamples) shows some various compound Poisson-gamma distributions, for different values of\ $\lambda$, $\alpha$ and\ $\beta$.



```{r PoissonGammaExamples, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Two compound Poisson--gamma models, both with mean and variance set to $1$. The solid dot at $X = 0$ represents the discrete probability.", fig.width=8, fig.height=4, out.width="90%"}
par( mfrow = c(1, 2))

x <- seq(from = 0,
         to =   5,
         length = 1000)

xi <- 22/21
mu <- 1
phi <- 1

alpha <- (2 - xi)/(xi - 1)
lambda <- mu^(2 - xi) / ( phi * (2 - xi))
beta <- phi * (xi - 1) / mu^(xi - 1)
p0 <- exp(-lambda)

# cat("alpha, beta, lambda, p0\n")
# cat(alpha, beta, lambda, p0, "\n")

y <-  tweedie::dtweedie(y = x,
               xi = xi,
               mu = mu,
               phi = phi)

plot(y[x > 0] ~ x[x > 0],
     type = "l",
     ylim = c(0, max(y)), 
     axes = FALSE,
     xlab = expression(italic(x)),
     ylab = expression(Prob.~"function"),
     main = expression(atop(Poisson*"-gamma"~distribution,
                            with~alpha==20)),
     lwd = 2)
abline(h = 0,
       col = "grey")
axis(side = 1)
axis(side = 2,
     at = p0,
     las = 1,
     labels = round(p0, 3))

points(x = 0,
       y = p0,
       pch = 19)
box()

#tweedie.convert(xi = xi,
#                mu = mu, 
#                phi = phi)


############################ 

xi <- 5/3 # ALPHA = 0.5
alpha <- 0.5

mu <- 1
phi <- 1

alpha <- (2 - xi)/(xi - 1)
lambda <- mu^(2 - xi) / ( phi * (2 - xi))
beta <- phi * (xi - 1) / mu^(xi - 1)
p0 <- exp(-lambda)

# cat(alpha, beta, lambda, p0, "\n")


y <- dtweedie(y = x,
              xi = xi,
              mu = mu,
              phi = phi)


plot(y[x > 0] ~ x[x > 0],
     type = "l",
     ylim = c(0, max( c(y, p0))), 
     axes = FALSE,
     xlab = expression(italic(x)),
     ylab = expression(Prob.~"function"),
     main = expression(atop(Poisson*"-gamma"~distribution,
                            with~alpha==0.5)),
     lwd = 2)
abline(h = 0,
       col = "grey")
axis(side = 1)
axis(side = 2,
     at = p0,
     las = 1,
     labels = round(p0, 3))
box()


points(x = 0,
       y = p0,
       pch = 19)
box()

#tweedie.convert(xi = xi,
#                mu = mu, 
#                phi = phi)

```
